summary: Modal.Title is a FIXED 16px (issue #51): body-lg at title-sm's 600 weight and body-lg's own 1.55 leading, replacing the fluid title-sm, which resolved to ~12px on a phone — smaller than the 14px fields a dialog holds. A dialog is a fixed-width surface, the rule lib/menu-surface already records for menus. On a desktop, where title-sm reaches its 16px cap, only the line grows (21.6px to 24.8px): at title-sm's 1.35 the footer button's hairline painted unevenly at some sub-pixel offsets. When the title is the surface's own child it also takes py-xs, so the bare heading clears the 16px corner on both axes as px-sm does horizontally. Consumers carrying the temporary [data-slot="modal-title"] font-size and padding-block patch can delete it.
